```js
await (async(page)=>{const p=page.context().browser().contexts().flatMap(c=>c.pages()).find(p=>p.url().startsWith('http://localhost:5214/'));const chat=p.getByTestId('floating-agent-chat-window');const state=await chat.getByTestId('agent-chat-run-state').innerText();const busy=await chat.getByTestId('chat-send-button').isDisabled();await chat.getByRole('button',{name:'Hide window',exact:true}).click();const dialog=p.getByTestId('floating-agent-chat-close-confirmation');await dialog.waitFor();const dialogText=await dialog.innerText();const stopDisabled=await p.getByTestId('floating-agent-chat-stop').isDisabled();await p.getByTestId('floating-agent-chat-keep-active').click();await chat.waitFor({state:'detached'});await p.getByTestId('floating-agent-catalog-window').getByRole('tab',{name:'Active',exact:true}).click();await p.waitForTimeout(600);const catalog=p.getByTestId('floating-agent-catalog-window');return {state,busy,dialogText,stopDisabled,catalog:await catalog.innerText(),buttons:await catalog.locator('[data-testid$="-open"]').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.getAttribute('data-testid')))};})(page);
```
